messages:
lia: FYI sample-app regression: embeddings pipeline double-indexing when using the new metadata flag. curl -> returns metadata, SDK call -> no metadata + duplicate jobs.

mark: can you show both calls?

lia: curl example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"inputs":["doc1"],"return_raw_metadata":true}'
```
returns metadata[].

lia: sdk (js-sdk v1.9.3):
```js
await client.embeddings.create({
  model: 'open-embed-1',
  inputs: ['doc1'],
  returnRawMetadata: true
});
```
no metadata and sample-app logs show two queue events q_2001 then q_2002.

tori: sounds like two issues: param mapping (camelCase -> snake_case missing) and retry semantics for 202. REST returns 202+Location while SDK treats non-200 as retryable.

mark: agree. Quick mitigation: update SDK to map returnRawMetadata -> return_raw_metadata and treat 202 from embeddings.batch as accepted (terminal). Add an e2e in sample-app to assert single enqueue when server returns 202.

lia: also noticed sample-app timeout is 10s; metadata fetch sometimes exceeds that causing client-side retry. Recommend bumping to 30s in template.

ops-bot: recent deploys: embeddings-service v3.2.6 at 2147889000; indexing-worker v2.5.1 at 2147889200

tori: I'll open two PRs: js-sdk#441 (param alias + mapping tests + CONTRIBUTING note) and js-sdk#442 (retry tweak + integration test). I'll include log snippets and an explicit test that mocks a 202 + Location header and asserts no retry.

mark: add a changelog entry and call out the behavioral difference in the SDK release notes. Also add a small note in sample-app README about the flag and expected latency for metadata.

lia: thanks. leaving this open until both PRs merged and sample-app template updated. :thumbsup:
